processing.local_dedupe.availability.rea: You are on local.folo.is in the browser: the processing service is available, but the on-device executor is not, so dedupe is owned by the processing service rules.
You are on the browser web app: the local executor is only provided by the Electron desktop app, so dedupe is owned by the processing service rules.

processing.local_dedupe.availability.una: This environment has no local executor, so the local fallback will not run.
processing.local_dedupe.description: This is the local fallback executor for the processing service's semantic dedupe rule. The main path is owned by the processing service (a local background service); when a subscription is not covered by the processing service, the desktop app runs an on-device model for an immediate, approximate dedupe. It only works on the Electron desktop app, and turning it off stops the client from doing any local dedupe. Note: the local fallback now covers every subscription category, which increases model usage.
processing.local_dedupe.enabled.descript: When off, the client no longer performs any local semantic dedupe; entries the processing service does not cover lose their immediate fallback.
processing.local_dedupe.enabled.label: Enable local fallback executor
